name: VM User Invite
description: One person, invited by phone number. This is the gate: without a Pending invite, a phone number that passes an OTP gets no account. Access is granted deliberately by somebody who knows who is joining, rather than by anybody who can receive an SMS.

fields.label: Phone Number
fields.description: Stored in the same normalised form the login path uses, so the gate cannot be missed by a stray +91 or a space.

fields.label: Full Name
fields.description: Seeds the new account, and is what the joiner sees pre-filled on their first screen. They can correct it.

fields.label: Email
fields.description: Where the welcome goes. Optional: not every driver has one, and the invite still works without it — they are simply told by their supervisor instead.

fields.label: Role
fields.description: What the account is created with. Left blank, the invite grants the app's default role.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Only Pending opens the gate. Accepted is stamped by the first successful login; Revoked closes it again without deleting the record of who was invited.

fields.label: User
fields.description: Filled in when the invite is accepted, so the invite and the account it produced can always be walked between.

fields.label: Welcome Sent At
fields.description: Blank with an email address present means the send failed — the invite still works, nobody was told.
